title: हराएको सूची
body: नयाँ रिपोर्ट: Rikesh Shrestha, Rudra Bahadur Ghale, Sumedha Amatya, Sadip Shrestha, Tamilarasi Asokan, Nishan Tamang, Subekshya Bhandari, Subesh Bhandari, Muyiya Bhandari, Ashen Tamang, Chessang Tamang, राजु चापागाई, Dorji Tamang, Bipin Tamang, Arushi Gupta, Kami Tamang, Tarsang Tamang, Srijana Acharya, Shiva Prasad Dhakal, Janani Sriram, Krishna Khatri, Pasang Tamang, Sriram Rajappa, Prabhakar Dangal, Aalok Kumar Paikra, Krishna Murari Aryal।
